LanguageData.OLWC_NotMechanitor: {0} needs a mechlink to command the resurrection core.
LanguageData.OLWC_NotOurMech: {0} is not one of your mechs.
LanguageData.OLWC_NotEnoughCharges: Resurrecting {0} needs {1} charges, but only {2} are left.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeRegen: The core recharges {0} of its capacity each day. The next charge will be ready in {1}.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeFull: The core is fully charged and recharges {0} of its capacity each day.
LanguageData.OLWC_GaugeCorpseAge: Mechs dead for up to {0} can be resurrected.
LanguageData.OLWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the overlord warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.OLWC_ChargesDesc: The number of resurrection charges the armor holds when full. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_RegenDesc: The percentage of the armor's charge capacity that recharges each day. At 0%, it will never recharge. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CorpseAgeDesc: How long after a mech's death it can still be resurrected, in real seconds at normal speed. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CastTimeDesc: How long the pilot takes to start a resurrection. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a resurrection before starting another. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.OLWC_RequireMechlinkDesc: When enabled, only a mechanitor pilot can use resurrect mech. When disabled, any pilot can resurrect your mechs.
LanguageData.OLWC_SparksOnlyDraftedDesc: When enabled, your pilots' armor will only crackle with red sparks while drafted. When disabled, the sparks will play whenever the armor holds a charge, as on an apocriton.
LanguageData.OLWC_ResurrectSummary: The armor holds up to {0} charges and {1}. Resurrecting a mech costs {2}, as long as it died within the last {3}. Resurrection takes {4} to cast, and the cooldown after is {5}.
LanguageData.OLWC_ResurrectSummaryNoCooldown: The armor holds up to {0} charges and {1}. Resurrecting a mech costs {2}, as long as it died within the last {3}. Resurrection takes {4} to cast, and the next can start at once.
LanguageData.OLWC_SectionWorkDesc: The work an overlord pilot can do. All other work follows VFE Pirates' warcasket rules, so mods that change those rules will change them for the overlord too.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkDesc: When enabled, overlord pilots can do this work, though you will need to assign it in the Work tab. When disabled, they cannot.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkNote_Research: Hacking is research work, so a pilot who cannot research cannot hack either.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkNote_Smithing: Mech gestation, subcore encoding and mech repair are smithing work.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkSummary: The pilot can take on {0} work. All other work follows VFE Pirates' warcasket rules.
LanguageData.OLWC_WorkSummaryNone: The pilot takes on none of this work. All other work follows VFE Pirates' warcasket rules.
